title: Mystery. Miracle. Time Slip!?
overview: Two twin girls from the future of Tamagotchi Planet make their mark to follow their dreams to become great fashion designers.

title: Full of Mystery!? X Kamen vs Miracrise!
overview: While Miraitchi and Clulutchi continue their quest to recover the Dreambakutchis, they encounter a shop that sounds suspicious to them.

title: Comrades to Believe in...Miracle Friends!
overview: Miraitchi and Clulutchi reveal to their new friends their secret of coming from the future.

title: Restored! Madamtchi's Sewing Machine
overview: The girls took an interest in Madamtchi's sewing machine, but it hasn't worked for a long time. While it is being checked, they heard that renowned craftsmen would be coming to town.

title: Miracle Shock! Apart for the First Time...
overview: The Designing School will be hosting a Dream Festival made up of teams of two. But the twin girls soon find themselves in a situation where they were forced to pair up with someone else rather than each other.

title: Worry? Cheery? Lucky Color of Dream
overview: The gang help a self-depressed painter regain her self-esteem in art composition.

title: Tama Pet Fashion Baku~n ♥
overview: Miraitchi and Clulutchi decide to hold a Tama Pet fashion service.

title: Worrying!? X Kamen's Identity
overview: Mametchi and the others try to work out the truth behind X Kamen's identity.

title: Doya! Tamaween Tumult
overview: The students of Dream School work together to prepare for the Tamaween Event.

title: Quickly Getting Closer! Tamatomo Smartotchi
overview: Smartotchi makes a living on his first day of Music Class at Dream School.

title: Rivals Today! Miracle Dorifes
overview: In the next upcoming dream festival, designing class will be put to the test once again to design the most fashionable outfit.

title: Welcome Back Yume Kira! Revival ☆ Kira Kira Girls
overview: Two familiar friends returned to Dream Town for a homecoming. But after hearing their story, the gang decided to hold a small concert to jump start their lagging dreams.

title: Dokidoki Bakubaku? Watchlin's Big Adventure!
overview: Watchlin accidentally lets one of the Dreambakutchis escape and she sets out to get it back herself before the others find out.

title: How Many Stars? Tama Auction Meeting!!
overview: Miraitchi and Clulutchi enter a Tama Auction together where they are tasked to design an outfit.

title: Gift ♪ Madamtchi's Present
overview: Miraitchi and Clulutchi try to find the perfect Christmas present for Madamtchi, with the help of their friends.

title: Another Merry Christmas ☆
overview: Santabluetchi seeks to give a present to his partner Bluenosetchi, but Santabluetchi does not know what Bluenosetchi wants.

title: Tsu-kun? Ma-kun? Refresh on the South Island
overview: Madamtchi's treats the gang to a tropical island vacation.

title: Too Amazing! Serious Mode of X-Kamen
overview: Everyone celebrates the Chinese New Year festival. But then another Dreambakutchi appears and the gang must capture it before X-Kamen does.

title: New Invention! Dreambakutchi Discovery Robo
overview: Mametchi invents a robot that can help Miraitchi and Clulutchi find Dreambakutchis.

title: I Also Came! Candy Pakupaku
overview: The Tama-Friend of Miraitchi and Clulutchi, Candy Pakupaku, arrives from the future.

title: Sad Future...X-Kamen's True Identity
overview: Candy Pakupaku captures X. But during investigation of another Dreambakutchi, X-Kamen appears...

title: The Dream of a Tama-Friend is the Dream of Everyone
overview: Miraitchi and Clulutchi unite with Smartotchi now that they understand his circumstances, and the gang promise to help their new Tama-Friend fulfill his dreams. Meanwhile, Ameartotchi is expressing mysterious behavior at Dream School...

title: Search! Jungle of Baku~!?
overview: While searching for the next Dreambakutchi with the entire gang, Pianitchi and Smartchi end up getting lost together.

title: Premonition of Farewell... Discovery! Greenbakutchi
overview: With all the Dreambakutchis collected, time travel back to the future is finally possible. This would mark the end of Miraitchi and Clulutchi's travels and Mametchi felt that it's time for his two new friends to part ways.

title: Smartotchi's Decision
overview: Smartchi learns the surprising effects of the Dreambakutchi and makes a decision.

title: Why Dolphin? Tell Us Dolphintchi
overview: A rare creature known as a Crescent Irukatchi arrives at the coast of Dream Town. But it appears to have a reason staying at the coast.

title: Where the Dream is Born
overview: A connection is discovered between the dreams of Crescent Irukatchi and Smartotchi.

title: Miracle of Dreambakutchi
overview: Something is going wrong in the future and everyone suspects that it's going under drastic changes.

title: Everyone's Dream...to the Future
overview: Everyone is now returning to their future. But Miraitchi and Clulutchi are reluctant to say their goodbyes to their friends.
